comparison.objective: Depanel a circuit board over a break edge and tray it; candidate removes open cartons from a running belt.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-921 tests bimanual registration, bracing, controlled bending fracture and post-break handling. Candidate tests moving-target capture, articulated-flap avoidance and level loaded transport.
comparison.success_condition: PR-921 requires a geometrically valid downward break, board-in-tray placement and stable released parts; invalid break direction or dropped parts score zero. Candidate has no fracture requirement and instead checks content retention and selective belt passage.
comparison.reason: Controlled material separation is a fundamentally different tested ability despite both ending with tray placement.
